thread:
maria: Kicking off ap-south-2 cluster bring-up. Short plan: cold-prefix hydration, 30m smoke at 10% traffic, then 4h staggered soak. Will monitor tail-latency, KV hit, and spot cost. @alex can you confirm node pools and image prepull?

alex: Pools provisioned: gpupool-1 (4xA100-40GB), gpupool-2 (6xA100-80GB), gpupool-spot (8xA40 spot). Images pre-pulled, model staging folder synced. Kube labels set: region=ap-south-2, pool=gpupool-1/2/spot.

jin: Canary on. Please keep p95 < 85ms during smoke. If tails spike, reduce max_batch to 3 and force local-kv-only for canary.

ops-bot: CI job queued: ci/infra/ap-south-2/provision/5498. Artifact -> https://ci.internal/artifacts/5498

alex: Started prefix replay to hydrate KV and filesystem caches. Using controlled fanout across AZs to limit egress.

lee: Noted: driver OOM warnings on one node in gpupool-spot during preload. Cordoned that node and started replacement from pool-2 spare. Collecting dmesg + nvidia-smi.

maria: Good catch. Pause spot reuse if more nodes show OOM. Also, network egress quota is 9Gbps for region — stagger downloads.

jin: Adjusted autoscaler: target_qps=55/node, scale_down_delay=2m, scale_up_cooldown=30s. Also lowered max_batch_kb to 300 for initial 2h.

alex: During the 30m smoke at 10%, metrics: p50=22ms p95=78ms errors=0.9% kv_hit=18% (warming). Autoscaler stable at 3 replicas per pool.

maria: Ramp schedule update: 0-30m smoke 10%, 30-120m ramp to 50%, 120-360m soak at 70% of projected steady-state. Abort if sustained p95 > 110ms or error > 2% for 10m.

lee: At 1h12m we saw an AZ routing flap (BGP reconverge). Affected AZ dropped traffic for ~6s, retries caused a transient error burst ~2.1% lasting 90s. Rebalanced traffic away from that AZ and tightened route failover to 250ms.

jin: After routing fix, tail latency improved. Current kv_hit=47% and token throughput ~66% of provisioned. Autoscaler scaled gpupool-1 from 3->8 replicas smoothly; no oscillation.

alex: Cost telemetry: spot pool activity pushed short-term unit cost +14%. Recommend pausing spot-preload during next region if cost sensitivity high.

maria: Handoff checklist for soak handoff to oncall (@lee): verify no cordoned nodes remaining, confirm kv cache >=40% within 2h, watch p95, error-rate, and billing anomaly. Escalation: paging SRE if p95>120ms for 5m.

ops-bot: Handoff logged. oncall=lee. Run artifacts: s3://redwood-run-artifacts/1994512345/

lee: Acknowledged. I'll keep dashboards open and open an incident if thresholds crossed. Scheduling post-soak retro at EOD to capture tuning notes.

maria: Post-run actions: collect node logs from replaced nodes, snapshot KV caches, and open tuning PR to lower scale_target for small models. Thanks team.

alex: Uploading nvidia-smi, pod logs, and preload timings to artifacts bucket now.

jin: Saved the autoscale config as autoscale/ap-south-2/v1.2 and tagged canary rollout. Traffic rollback plan in place (reduce to 5% in <2m). Keep posting anomalies here.

maria: Closing thread unless new anomalies appear. Nice baseline; next region we'll try more aggressive prefetch settings.
